prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Pet Profile Summary", "Review your companion's traits before bringing them to your desktop environment.", "Select Primary Behavior"]
1: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to access, hide, and interact with your companion anytime using taskbar tray controls.", "Press Alt+P anytime to switch desktop pet overlay mode."]
2: ["Signing in with your existing account restores your saved desktop pets and preferences automatically."]
3: ["Select Your Onboarding Journey", "Pick between quick instant adoption or creating a custom desktop companion.", "Available Paths"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "Generating companion animations and setting up tray controls."]
5: ["Review Pet Visual Preview", "Confirm lighting and visual framing before initiating desktop generation.", "Approve & Continue"]
6: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "If your pet disappears, click the tray icon in your taskbar or press Alt+P to toggle visibility."]
7: ["For crisp desktop pet visuals, use clear, well-lit photos with a centered subject."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you as soon as your pet arrives on screen."]
9: ["Includes Starter Desk Accessory"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bundled items
